That is with every regime's growth spread × 1.5, the one number fitted on these outcomes (and used here): as the hidden Markov model estimates them, the range held 68% (18% below, 14% above) — a single year's regime spread understates how far revenue can drift over several.

current assets less all liabilities is negative (−$5.96 a share): no net-net value — normal for a company funded by long-term debt
needs a positive normalized operating margin and the WACC (not for banks or insurers)
pays no dividend (or its cost of equity is within a point of the terminal growth)
only for companies with at least $25M of revenue and an operating loss, or negative free cash flow at an operating margin under 5%

stage.label: Cyclical
stage.why: quarterly operating margin σ 25.4 points, revenue growth +19.5%
stage.rule: a cyclical industry (mining, energy, chemicals, metals, autos, semiconductors, airlines, homebuilders, shipping) or a quarterly operating margin with σ above 8 points
